label: D2 after a1->S1 common transition, late in the episode (trial >= ~85)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO), and almost only when the reached state shown is S1 after choosing a1 (a common transition; in_state==1 alone covers 99.6% of activations, in_action==2 / S2 almost never). It is also gated by time in the episode: nothing before trial ~70, 19% of the mass in trials 80-89, 80% in trials 90-99. Equivalently it tracks the low value-head output near the end of the episode (76% of the mass is in the lowest value bin). The firing rate rises with episode trial. The predicate uses only observed inputs plus an episode-time proxy. Dev F1 0.80, mass recall 0.94. What it misses: D2 S1-common steps at trials 70-85 (mostly weak activations). False positives are late-episode S1c steps that stay inactive. Top activations tend to follow unrewarded or rare previous trials, but excluding common-rewarded previous trials hurt F1, so that is not claimed as a rule. Does not fire on S2, rare transitions, or early-episode trials.
